art.why: An island landscape seen from its rocks: Gaunilo's island (a real island, not a perfect one; the description shows land and hills, not open sea).

art.title: The Dream of Saint Catherine of Alexandria
art.why: A vision scene: a sleeping saint visited by Mary, the child and angels; for what Aquinas saw that made his writing 'straw'. (Catherine was the patron of philosophers: say so only as background.)

music.why: Ordered, intelligible polyphony: faith given a reasoned form.
